observations.detail: On TEST-01 only, added a temporary enabled Windows Defender Firewall outbound Block rule for TCP remote 192.168.1.100:8443. Validated exact remote address and port, TEST-02 DNS resolution to 192.168.1.100, and TEST-01 TCP connect failure. SSH to TEST-01 remained functional. TEST-02 VentioHost and PostgreSQL remained running; authenticated local Host records query returned eight rows throughout isolation.

Actual TEST-01 installed native New Asset form saved name test01 isolated client network 20261122. Read-only copied installed SQLite local_commands showed extension.record.create command 1d20a93f-b904-416a-ba34-706133ca3e68 PENDING, attempt 0 with no Host receipt. Native Host-backed Asset list showed HOST_REQUEST_TIMEOUT rather than stale Host data; authenticated TEST-02 Host query remained at eight records.
Removed only the exact named and scope-validated temporary firewall rule. Verified no matching rule remained and TEST-01 TCP connected again to 192.168.1.100:8443.

Invoked native TEST-01 Sync pending. Installed SQLite changed the exact command to ACCEPTED, attempt 1 with Host receipt revision 1. Authenticated TEST-02 Host query rose from eight to nine records and included exactly one test01 isolated client network 20261122. Repeated native Sync pending left Host count nine and command at attempt 1.

limits: This case verified client-only TCP Host isolation, not entire network adapter detachment.
Full corrected Client/Host installation candidate and upgrade still await hosted release artifact.
TEST-02 native Client visual confirmation of the ninth row remains separate; authoritative Host query verified it.
